answer: New identities earn non-transferable reputation only by completing verified work: ten client-signed tasks over 90 days, each receipt on-chain, before full payouts unlock. Like trees in an orchard, reputation grows slowly and cannot be transplanted to a fresh fake. Each extra fake must repeat the whole 90-day history, so 100 fakes cost 100 times the labour and waiting, while idle reputation decays 10% monthly like marble worn by weather. A fake that skips the queue strands at the jetty with no cargo. Verifiers replay task receipts and decay math to confirm every standing.
